title: Every lead is a scored node in a small graph of people, venues and referrers, and a strong one approves itself
description: On 2026-11-11 the Owner asked for the launch machine v2 (Loop 1 Find and Loop 5 Grow). Today a hunt lead is a row that only knows its own address, so venue and referral leverage cannot be computed and every lead waits for a tap. flows/leads.ts keeps a lead graph per flow in $FW_HOME/flows/<flow>/leads.json: nodes { id, kind person|venue, name, niche, town, contact_routes [{ kind email|dm|form, value, public_source_url }], source_url, last_event_at, current_tool, consent_note, state proposed|approved|dropped, score { p_reply, p_publish, leverage, timing, value }, links { venues, events, referred_by }, warm met_in_person|referred|null, created_at }. It reads the drafts the hunts already write (read only) and upserts nodes, deduped by normalized email, handle, a venue's own domain, and name plus town; a person found on a venue's own site links to that venue. The Owner pastes people met in person (POST /v1/flows/{key}/leads/paste { text }, one per line: name, where met, contact), which become warm nodes; the text is data. value = p_reply x p_publish x leverage x timing: warm beats cold, a public contact of their own and recent activity raise p_reply; recurring events, ticket fees and a known niche raise p_publish; a venue's teacher count and a person's venues and referrals raise leverage; timing is the half-life on the last public activity. At or above the approve threshold (config leads.auto_approve_at, default 0.6) a node approves itself, from 0.45 it stays proposed, below it drops; do-not-contact and restricted regions (EU, EEA, UK, Canada) always drop. GET /v1/flows/{key}/leads?state= lists nodes, POST .../leads/{id}/approve and .../drop are the Owner's tap (approving a blocked node answers 409). The graph refreshes after each hunt cycle and once a day. No em dashes.
acceptance: Two hunt results for the same person dedupe to one node with both events
A venue and two teachers found on its site link, and the teachers raise the venue's leverage above a venue with none
A strong lead approves itself, a borderline one stays proposed, and do-not-contact and restricted leads drop
The Owner can approve or drop a node, the choice survives a refresh, and approving a blocked node is refused
A paste of three names met in person makes three warm person nodes, and pasting them again makes no more
